texts:
Sunday moved three backfields and benched a quarterback mid-game.

Kendre Miller took over in New Orleans.

Cam Skattebo played six snaps.

Rico Dowdle came back in Pittsburgh.

Here is what's still good from Week 6.

Let's get into it.
#Saints #NYGiants #HereWeGo

Kendre Miller played 32 snaps and ran 20 times for 70 @NYG. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Alvin Kamara scored on a catch but sat the fourth quarter with the back. RB45 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report.
#Saints #NYGiants

Cam Skattebo played 6 snaps with no carries vs NO, a week after his fourth lost fumble. Hold him; the Week 7 depth chart decides it.

Tyrone Tracy Jr. scored twice on 8 touches. A deep-league add, 0 to 2 percent.
#NYGiants #Saints

Rico Dowdle was back: 7 carries for 40 @TB, close to even early.

Jaylen Warren closed it, 4 carries and a catch on the overtime drive. RB23 rest of season for me; hold him.

Monitor Dowdle's snap share vs NO in Week 7.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Thursday night first.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba drew 16 targets and caught 12 for 134 @DEN. WR2 rest of season for me.

George Holani out-snapped Emanuel Wilson 49 to 27 and scored. Drop Wilson for any add on the list.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

J.K. Dobbins played 31 snaps to RJ Harvey's 24, and each scored. Harvey got 4 targets back. RB33 rest of season for me; hold Harvey.

Jaylen Waddle hurt his shoulder before halftime. WR15 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report.
#BroncosCountry #Seahawks

London.

Woody Marks ran 15 times for 56 with David Montgomery out, and Montgomery may miss Week 7 too. RB40 rest of season for me; hold Marks.

Marvin Harrison Jr. ran 9 routes in his debut, 3 for 34. Monitor his route share vs NYG.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

Bhayshul Tuten ran 12 times for 39 and caught 4 for 48 and 2 TDs. Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran 11 for 55. RB18 rest of season for me; hold Tuten.

Parker Washington drew 11 targets, 4 for 64. Hold him.
#DUUUVAL #HTownMade

Caleb Williams went 30 of 36 for 305 in his return @ATL and hit his first 12 throws. QB10 rest of season for me; trade for him in superflex, offer a WR3.

Luther Burden III caught all 8 targets for 95. Trade for him; offer a WR4 and a bench RB.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Baltimore lost Rashod Bateman to a shoulder injury @CLE. Monitor Wednesday's report.

Ja'Kobi Lane caught 4 of 5 for 40 off IR. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.

Zay Flowers drew 11 targets with Tyler Huntley. WR9 rest of season for me.
#RavensFlock #DawgPound

Quinshon Judkins sat with the ankle. RB20 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report.

Audric Estime and Jaleel McLaughlin split 18 carries for 60 and a TD. Leave both on waivers.

Jerry Jeudy caught all 4 targets for 69. Hold him.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

A.J. Brown drew 10 targets in his return and caught 3 for 27 with 3 drops. WR24 rest of season for me; hold him.

Romeo Doubs hurt his shoulder on a 42-yard TD, and Vrabel would not commit to him. Monitor Tuesday's report before Thursday @CHI.
#NEPats #JetUp

DeMario Douglas caught 7 of 8 for 86 and a TD. Add him for Thursday in PPR, 1 to 3 percent.

Braelon Allen ran 17 times for 78 with Breece Hall out. RB49 rest of season for me; hold him while Hall sits.
#NEPats #JetUp

Chuba Hubbard ran 28 times for 120 and a TD @PHI, and no other Carolina back had more than 1 carry. RB25 rest of season for me; trade for him, offer a WR3.

Jalen Coker drew 13 targets, 6 for 97. WR34 rest of season for me; hold him.
#KeepPounding #FlyEaglesFly

Dameon Pierce had every Philadelphia rushing yard, 12 for 35 and a TD, with Saquon Barkley out again. Hold Pierce until Barkley practices in full.

DeVonta Smith drew 14 targets from Tanner McKee, 7 for 75 and a TD. WR12 rest of season for me.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80 @LAR on 44 percent of the snaps. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.

Tyler Allgeier ran 18 times for 38. Drop him for any add on the list.

Jeremiyah Love is RB15 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's report.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

Kyren Williams touched the ball a season-low 13 times. RB12 rest of season for me; hold him.

Blake Corum scored for the second straight week. RB27 rest of season for me; hold him as the handcuff.
#RamsHouse #BirdGang

Germie Bernard drew 12 targets, caught 11 for 87 and won it in overtime @TB. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent.

Bucky Irving got 19 of Tampa Bay's 21 back carries, for 46. RB17 rest of season for me; hold him.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Carnell Tate caught 6 of 7 for 70 and his first TD @IND. WR32 rest of season for me; hold him.

Tony Pollard ran a season-high 19 times for 76. RB30 rest of season for me; hold him.
#TitanUp #ForTheShoe

James Cook had 153 yards from scrimmage and a TD @LV. RB7 rest of season for me.

Tre Tucker had 5 for 97 and 2 TDs. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.

Ashton Jeanty out-touched Mike Washington Jr. 14 to 10 but split early downs. RB8 rest of season; hold.
#BillsMafia #RaiderNation

Kenneth Walker III ran 19 times for 128 and 2 TDs vs LAC. RB4 rest of season for me.

Ladd McConkey left with a concussion, and LAC is off in Week 7. WR21 rest of season for me; monitor the protocol over the bye.
#ChiefsKingdom #BoltUp

Pierre Strong Jr. out-snapped MarShawn Lloyd 41 to 30. Drop Lloyd for any add on the list.

Josh Jacobs is expected back for Week 7. RB37 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday.

CeeDee Lamb drew 18 targets, 9 for 70. WR4 for me.
#GoPackGo #DallasCowboys

Real.

Chuba Hubbard's 28 carries are a workhorse role.

Noise.

Bijan Robinson got 11 touches; Chicago kept the ball 40 minutes. RB2 rest of season for me; hold him.

Jonathan Taylor had 151 scrimmage yards. RB3 for me; hold him.
#KeepPounding #DirtyBirds #ForTheShoe

The misses.

Bijan Robinson was RB1 for me; 11 touches.

Cam Skattebo was RB17; 6 snaps.

Emanuel Wilson was RB16; 32 percent of the snaps.

Pat Freiermuth was TE12; 2 catches for 11.
#DirtyBirds #NYGiants #Seahawks #HereWeGo

Every takeaway, usage note and overreaction from Week 6 is on the site, with Monday night going into Tuesday's waiver run.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the waiver calls tomorrow, and repost this for your league.
